seed.tagline: One script that ships your backend API as a cpln workload.
seed.description: Adds a deploy/ folder with deploy.sh: it builds the backend's generated Node API into an image, pushes it to your Control Plane org's registry and applies a workload in the GVC you choose. The build does not run it; you run ./deploy/deploy.sh when you want to ship.
seed.requiresInput: A Control Plane org, a GVC in it and a service-account token

replacements.label: Control Plane org
replacements.description: The cpln org the image is pushed to and the workload runs in.

replacements.label: GVC
replacements.description: The global virtual cloud the workload is applied to.

replacements.label: Workload name
replacements.description: The cpln workload (and image) name for the API.

replacements.label: Control Plane token
replacements.description: A service-account token that can push images and apply workloads in that org. Kept in your account's secret store, read by deploy.sh at deploy time, never printed.
